## Questions and setup help

Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Sodastream1218/SodaEconomy/discussions) for:

- installation and configuration questions;
- choosing YAML, SQLite, or MySQL;
- Vault/Floodgate setup guidance;
- general usage questions;
- community examples and ideas that are not yet concrete feature requests.

## Bugs

Use the repository's **Bug report** issue form. Include:

- exact SodaEconomy version;
- Paper/Purpur and Java versions;
- selected storage backend;
- installed integrations;
- reproducible steps;
- sanitized logs and relevant configuration;
- whether the issue persists on the latest available build.

Do not report a problem only as “it does not work.” Reports without enough information may be closed
until reproduction details are available.

## Feature requests

Use the **Feature request** issue form. Explain the actual use case, expected behavior, alternatives,
and affected subsystem. Major architectural requests may be moved to a Discussion before acceptance.

## Security vulnerabilities

Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). Never disclose unresolved exploit details in a public issue.

## Unsupported environments

Support is not currently claimed for Folia, Bukkit/Spigot-only environments, Paper below the documented
minimum, modified forks, or Java versions below the supported runtime. See the compatibility document
before filing an issue.

## Response expectations

SodaEconomy is maintained independently. Support is provided as time permits; opening duplicate issues,
pinging repeatedly, or demanding deadlines does not speed up a response.

## Licensing and branding questions

Read `LICENSE`, `LICENSE-FAQ.md`, and `TRADEMARKS.md` before opening a
question. Public discussions may clarify project policy but cannot grant an
exception to the license. Requests for commercial permission must receive
express written authorization from the Licensor.
